subject.title: fix(ci): unbreak main check lanes — stale ratchet baselines and unexported sqlite-reliability contract types

question: Should maintainers adopt this narrow patch despite the contribution rule, or close it and apply the same repair through a maintainer-owned branch?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and useful, but repository policy explicitly rejects contributor PRs whose sole purpose is repairing failures already present on `main`; choosing whether to make an exception requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Apply Internally
options.body: Close this contributor PR after applying the equivalent patch on current `main`, rerunning the three focused checks, and retaining contributor credit.

options.title: Merge As Exception
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current `main`, rerun the three focused checks, and merge it as an explicit exception to the contribution rule.

recommendation.title: Apply Internally
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR after applying the equivalent patch on current `main`, rerunning the three focused checks, and retaining contributor credit.
